1.consolidated_definition: Planta arbustiva de hasta 8 m de altura, en forma de palmera, con copa redonda, corteza gris verdosa con manchas amarillentas, hojas anchas con el borde sinuoso de color verde siena, pequeñas flores amarillentas y fruto elíptico; la infusión de sus flores tiene diversas aplicaciones en la medicina tradicional. (Caricaceae; Carica papaya).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub-like plant reaching up to 8 m in height, palm-like in shape with a rounded crown, grey-green bark with yellowish spots, broad leaves with a wavy margin of siena green color, small yellow flowers and elliptical fruit; the infusion of its flowers has various applications in traditional medicine. (Caricaceae; Carica papaya).
